title: Cushions Work Like Boats
description: Makes entities that can sit in boats able to ride on cushions including most mobs, and items.
body:
# Cushions Work Like Boats ![There should be a yellow cushion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c669150261b2747c51b7edf22085d6b8da1aacb2.png)

Makes some mobs to sit on cushions. This only works for mobs that can be pushed onto boats. 
This also seems to include items.

## Additonal Detals
- Limited to only one mob per cushion. 
- The nearest mob within one block of a cushion sits.
- This is only if the cushion is unoccupied.
